parent.frozen_r47_mechanism: two-seed simple learned-key DEV PASS on synthetic; no Native backbone gain; independent scientific PASS false

hypothesis.primary: An actually trained content selector can condition the public B role/tag preference on an independently observed public context, choosing the high-tag causal record for context 0 but the low-tag causal record for context 1, where a single global learned positive or negative tag slope cannot solve both.
hypothesis.disambiguator: Positive source-only control must decode fifth after-state against FIT-only baseline, distinguish opposite signed B causal effects by public context-dependent tag role, and select return action without evaluator-only metadata.
hypothesis.native: Compare Native-augmented contextual head with same train/observation budget, but require positive Native ablation gain and compute matched before asserting Native-specific improvements.
hypothesis.null: If either original seed fails FIT/CAL/OOD, context-specific selector is unnecessary under ablation, or conventional controls dominate, reject frozen claim without tuning spent score cohorts.

source.cue_role_mapping: context 0: cue observed tag state 0.42, decoy observed tag state 0.18; context 1: cue observed tag state 0.18, decoy observed tag state 0.42. No public metadata identifies cue or role beyond selected action keys, selected measured effects and context.
source.selected_B_delta: cue +amplitude*gate, decoy -amplitude*gate; remaining selected nuisance depends only on panel, group and time and is independent of gate
source.positions: SHA256-derived distinct positions per (panel,group) shared across both contexts and gate signs; no generator index supplied to learner
source.public_record: Use R29B selected _record(state_tag, selected_action, state_tag+delta, public_context), then mask B effect[4]=0. Do not alter physical effect[0] or action key.
source.source_parity: Opposite gates with matched (panel,group,context,q_sign) must have identical entire 16-channel public B mean and action-key mean; their individual selected B effects must differ.
source.fifth: Only actually selected probe 0.42 action=public_context outcome via original R32 quartic with q sign. Decode measured after=before+inverse(normalized selected physical delta).
source.fit_offset: Calibrate zero-q fifth after-state exclusively from first 16 balanced FIT-group selected factual probe measurements, no hidden q/gate labels or CAL/OOD data.
source.return: R32 quartic original for FIT/CAL and R41 cubic original for OOD, return state 0.61 or 0.73 by group parity; physical regret=(after-1.0)^2, no double-adding state.

arms.name: context_key_selector
arms.description: Two differentiable slopes selected by actual public context 0/1, initialized 0/0; a trained gain; softmax over actually observed tag action keys and selected B physical effects.

arms.name: global_key_selector
arms.description: One global trainable tag slope shared across contexts, same FIT-only fifth calibration, trainable gain, identical selected factual training.

arms.name: uniform_key_selector
arms.description: Both role slopes fixed at 0, trainable gain only; same selected observations.

arms.name: context_key_native
arms.description: Context-dependent learned selector plus truly trainable Native R34 factual-memory backbone and fusion; no Native-specific claim without ablation.

arms.name: gru_context_control
arms.description: Independent fully trainable GRU over same selected public B tag/effect sequence with public context explicitly read to choose causal action, FIT-only probe calibration, same optimizer-update budget.

methods.optimizer: AdamW, lr=.02 on slopes/readout gain, lr=.001 on GRU/Native, weight_decay=0, clip_norm=1; all arms same 256 updates and factual paired data
frozen_ablation_panels: force context 0 slope on both contexts
methods.diagnostic: Record slope at checkpoints for both contexts, initial true gradients for both slopes, CE/heldout, trainable parameters, full-process CPU cost, categorical action vectors with context subgroup.
methods.whole_process_compute_capacity_qualifica: Report parameter/CPU/updates; superiority vs much larger GRU/Native cannot be declared as capacity-matched without separate proof.

frozen_dev_score.if_fail: Keep all original scores and negative outcomes, no post-evaluation retune or source reuse.
frozen_dev_score.attribution: Passing context selector demonstrates only conditional factual-key learning on synthetic distribution; native-only attribution separately requires positive zero-Native ablation and matching strong controls.

qualification: Exact SHA: full G4 unchanged Windows+Ubuntu, G5 actual TTT CPU both, G7 pinned Mamba2 Ubuntu, original ZIP+JSON hashes, full categorical cross-OS decision parity.
